verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents user-built agent workflows (Agent Flows, custom agent workflows) and a built-in automatic meeting transcription and summarization feature. Nothing in the evidence shows user-configured automations being scheduled, triggered, or run unattended in the background; the Agent Flows evidence is only a page title. Missing for 10: scheduling or trigger-based execution, evidence that flows run autonomously without a live chat session, in-depth docs on automation behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
